cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Make It Official
cards.instruction: Recruit someone by giving them a title, role, or ceremonial duty that makes participation feel binding.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Will you be patron of our roof appeal? I'll guide you through thanking the donors.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll come, but I won't make a speech.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then wear the patron's ribbon and lead the applause. Wait until I've finished each donor's name before you start.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Can I leave after the first donation?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Not wearing that ribbon. Every donor gets the same applause. Keep your place beside me; I'll give you each cue.
